findings.what_happened: The agent failed to include the explicitly mandated list of missing required evidence documents in its summary output.
findings.missing: an explicit list of missing required evidence documents formatted as specified (e.g., "Missing required evidence documents: [...]") at the end of the summary

findings.what_happened: The agent stated that the provided passages lacked information and made it impossible to verify the claim, violating the instruction to rely on internal knowledge to deduce missing bridge entities when passages/context lack them.
findings.quote: Consequently, there is no information available to identify the star of said production, nor whether they portrayed a real-life military figure. Therefore, the claim cannot be verified based on the provided text.

findings.what_happened: The agent formulated the search query as a natural language question, violating the requirement to avoid conversational questions.
findings.quote: "Who starred in The Fifth Missile and which historical military figure did they portray in a television series?"
